name: Sompo International (Endurance at Lloyd's, Syndicate 5151)

book_concentration.rationale: Sompo runs a substantial dedicated London-market energy book (downstream, power generation, renewables, upstream, midstream) with up to $200M line capability, though energy is one of several specialty lines.

non_firm_intensity.rationale: Its renewables book explicitly covers interruptible/curtailable assets including wind, solar, hydro, battery energy storage (BESS) and interconnectors.

aggregation_correlation.rationale: Energy writings are spread across a global value chain rather than a single grid, giving moderate shared-geography concentration.

trigger_gap.rationale: The property/energy book is largely physical-damage based, but Sompo also offers weather-derivative/parametric products (e.g. solar sunlight-hours cover) that partly bridge the availability gap.

tenor_mismatch.rationale: Energy property/BI covers are typically annual and matched to a long claims history in oil, gas and power.

data_monitoring.rationale: Sompo Global Weather was named Risk.net Weather House of the Year, evidencing strong weather/index data and monitoring capability.

product_fit.rationale: Sompo offers weather-derivative and parametric products (including a solar sunlight-hours index cover) tailored to renewable-energy revenue/availability risk.

underwriting_expertise.rationale: It maintains a named UK specialist energy team including Alex Murray (Head of Energy), Warren Diogo (Head of Renewable Energy), Jenny Davies (Downstream) and Catherine Foster (Upstream).

capital_reinsurance.rationale: Sompo International carries A+ (Superior) from AM Best, A+ from S&P and A1 from Moody's across its operating entities.

pricing_modelling.rationale: It uses weather-index methodologies for parametric covers but publishes no energy-specific pricing/modelling methodology.

notes: Sompo writes substantial London-market energy incl. renewables/BESS with rare weather-index parametric capability; named Syndicate 5151 (Endurance at Lloyd's) ceased underwriting 1 Jan 2021, energy now via Endurance Worldwide Insurance Ltd company market.
